overrides_hero_kpi.label_en: Communications, Media and Technology segment revenue
overrides_hero_kpi.label_fr: Revenus du segment Communications, Médias et Technologie
overrides_hero_kpi.rationale_segment_specific: The 'Communications, Media and Technology' segment revenue is the operational metric that aligns with the hero KPI 'CMT_Revenue'. Values are explicitly reported in both the FY2024 and FY2021 10-K filings across six consecutive fiscal years (2018–2023), with the latest filing taking precedence for overlapping years. All values are literal and reported in millions of dollars.

hero_kpi_replaced_reason: Orphelin résolu par fallback sectoriel 'Technologie'. Hero précédent 'Op Margin' avait history insuffisant. Remplaçant 'Total Revenue' choisi parmi liste sectorielle (history=4, period=year). Stratégie B fix-hero-orphan.
